Marcus L: Morning all — first day on-site. Monitor box showed up but the PSU/power brick was missing and it only has an HDMI cable. My company MacBook is USB-C only so I can't get a signal. Also when I try to sign into the office Wi‑Fi the captive portal just sits on 'Loading...' and never shows the login. Who handles parts/shipping and Wi‑Fi portal issues?
Dana (IT): welcome, Marcus! sorry about the missing parts. Can you paste the UPS tracking/label? We'll open a parts ticket and pull a spare USB‑C power brick & dongle if available. For the captive portal, can you try an incognito window or a direct URL: http://wifi-login.internal — sometimes Chrome extensions block the redirect. What desk are you at?
Marcus L: Tracking UPS 1ZABC1234509876543. Desk is 3B (near kitchen). Tried incognito already, still spinner. Using Safari on a personal profile Mac managed by MDM.
it-bot: IT ticket created: IT-2026-512. Assigned to Dana (IT). Add details at https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/IT-2026-512
Dana (IT): thanks — ticket IT-2026-512. I'll check the delivery contents and push for same‑day fulfillment from spares. A couple troubleshooting steps while we arrange parts: on macOS, open System Settings -> Network -> Wi‑Fi -> Advanced and remove the 'Redwood-Employee' network, then reconnect and accept the new profile. If that fails, try flushing DNS:
```bash
sudo dscacheutil -flushcache; sudo killall -HUP mDNSResponder
```
On Windows you'd do:
```powershell
ipconfig /flushdns
netsh winsock reset
```
Marcus L: ran the mac flush, still stuck. When I try http://wifi-login.internal it redirects briefly then shows blank. No prompt for credentials.
Ops Scheduler: I've got a spare USB‑C power brick and a USB‑C to HDMI dongle in the office spares cabinet. I can drop them to desk 3B at 4:00pm today. Do you want the dongle or prefer we ship a USB‑C to DisplayPort cable?
Marcus L: HDMI dongle is fine for now. Thanks!
Asha (People Ops): @Marcus welcome! sorry for the rough start — if the monitor stand/arm or any desk accessories are missing, reply here and we'll add them to your new hire kit immediately.
Dana (IT): I pushed a device enrollment check to the MDM for your laptop — sometimes captive portal is blocked until the device is fully enrolled. If your machine is flagged, the MDM will install the Wi‑Fi cert automatically. In the ticket I listed the manual cert URL as a fallback: https://internal.redwood/certs/employee-wifi.pem (install into System -> Keychain -> login, set to Always Trust).
Marcus L: I installed the cert from the link, now getting a username prompt. Is that my Okta email and usual password?
Dana (IT): yes, use your RedID (email). If MFA prompts, approve the Okta push. If the portal still doesn't accept creds, reply on the ticket and I'll remote in.
it-bot: Ticket IT-2026-512 status changed: Open -> Awaiting Parts. ETA parts delivery: same day (Ops drop).
Ops Scheduler: Dropping spares at 4:00pm. Marcus I'll knock when I arrive so you know.
Marcus L: perfect. Appreciate everyone helping on day one. I'll update the ticket if anything changes.
Dana (IT): closing the loop here — parts en route and cert steps in ticket. If Wi‑Fi remains flaky after the dongle/power & MDM, ping me directly and I'll remote in. Welcome to Redwood! :tada:
